data.name: Bhimsen
data.gender_notes: Bhimsen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhimsen is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'powerful' or 'strong'. In Hindu mythology, Bhimsen is an avatar of Lord Vishnu, known for his immense strength and courage. The name Bhimsen carries the meaning “Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhimsen usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and bravery needed to overcome challenges in life.
data.etymology: Bhimsen belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhimsen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It is a popular name among Hindus and is often associated with strong characters in art, literature, and media.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhimsen: The name Bhimsen signifies the embodiment of strength and courage. Bhim, an avatar of Lord Vishnu, represents raw power and unyielding determination. Sen signifies the leader or the ruler, symbolizing Bhimsen as a strong and courageous leader.
